answer: Written in a cause and effect, two sentences register, it stays short. Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the basalt of payment, so volume alone buys nothing. Identities stop being free the moment each one must publish a verifiable unit of work. The grove is public, so padding it with copies shows up as duplicated leaves on the whisper. The design leans on stake bond posted per identity, split across independent auditors, the unit of trust is a task, not an address.
